resources.string: Encrypted storage is unavailable. Existing records are preserved. Public Safety help remains available.
The timer action could not finish. Check the saved timer state before trying again.
Generic timer completion alerts. System volume, Do Not Disturb and channel settings apply.
Notifications are unavailable. The saved timer and foreground countdown still work; no background completion alert is promised.
Exact alarm access is off. Background completion is approximate and may be delayed.
Exact alarm access is enabled. Device battery settings, volume and Do Not Disturb can still affect alerts.
Working… Your records stay unchanged if this fails.
Preview the exact content first. Markdown is not encrypted. The selected file provider may sync it elsewhere. Safety is always excluded.
Back up organiser plans, reviews and timer history with a password. Safety, support contacts, keys and device settings are excluded.
Delete all local records, private Safety contacts and encryption keys, and cancel timers. This cannot be undone. Previously exported files and copies on other devices must be deleted separately.
Use at least 12 characters. Keep the password somewhere safe: it is never stored here and cannot be recovered.
This replaces existing organiser records. Your local Safety plan and contacts stay unchanged. Restored timers stay stopped.
File selection cancelled. Your records are unchanged.
Export could not be saved. Check the date, destination and available storage, then try again.
Markdown saved to your chosen file.
Backup could not be created or saved. Your records are unchanged.
Encrypted backup saved. Keep its password safe.
The password or backup is invalid, unsupported or too large. Your records are unchanged.
Restore failed. Existing records were preserved.
Organiser records restored. Timer history stays stopped.
Deletion could not finish. Keep this app open and try again.
Local records and keys deleted. Public help remains available.
